subject.statement: Charlie Javice (founder of the startup Frank)

summary: As of 2026-10-13, the verdict is ADVERSE (99% confidence). The decisive adverse facts are: Charlie Javice was arrested in April 2023 for fraud, convicted in September 2025 on multiple fraud counts and sentenced to 85 months in prison, and the SEC charged her with fraud in connection with the $175 million sale of Frank to JPMorgan Chase in 2021.

findings.statement: Charlie Javice was arrested in April 2023 for allegedly orchestrating a scheme to fraudulently induce JPMorgan Chase to acquire Frank for $175 million.
Charlie Javice was convicted of conspiracy, wire fraud, bank fraud and securities fraud and sentenced to 85 months in prison in September 2025.
The SEC charged Charlie Javice with fraud in connection with the $175 million sale of Frank to JPMorgan Chase in 2021.

minor_adverse_items: Charlie Javice is the founder of the student loan assistance startup Frank. (unrated; americanbanker.com)
Charlie Javice is the founder of a startup that aimed to revolutionize how college students apply for financial aid (Frank). (unrated; npr.org)
